entries.logic: Uses BorderPane as the primary container. Top: Menubar + Toolbar. Center: SplitPane (Navigation + Workspace). Bottom: StatusBar.
entries.implementation: BorderPane root = new BorderPane(); root.setTop(vboxWithMenuAndToolbar); root.setCenter(splitPane);
entries.rationale: Provides a consistent and familiar IDE-like experience, optimized for productivity and space management.

entries.logic: A fixed-width or resizable pane (SplitPane) on the left side, containing project trees or category navigation.
entries.rationale: Separates context (navigation) from the primary action area (workspace), reducing cognitive load.

entries.logic: An HBox containing status messages on the left and metadata (like version) on the right, separated by an adaptive spacer.
entries.implementation: HBox.setHgrow(spacer, Priority.ALWAYS); HBox statusBar = new HBox(status, spacer, version);
entries.rationale: Ensures critical application state is always visible without interrupting the user workflow.

entries.logic: A VBox with centered alignment (Pos.CENTER) containing high-level project actions and branding. Typically set as the initial 'Center' node of the Workspace.
entries.implementation: setAlignment(Pos.CENTER); setSpacing(20); getChildren().addAll(title, version, newBtn, openBtn);
entries.rationale: Guides the user during the first launch, providing clear entry points to primary application features.
